title: The Future of Intelligent Healthcare: A Systematic Analysis and Discussion on the Integration and Impact of Robots Using Large Language Models for Healthcare

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual analysis and literature review of LLM performance disparities across different languages and dialects (e.g., referencing MMLU benchmark differences) and how they create inequalities in healthcare access and quality of care.

Theoretical evaluation of how skewed internet training data results in unrepresentative health knowledge, potentially exacerbating equality gaps and leading to culturally inappropriate medical advice for minority demographic groups.

Conceptual analysis of how probabilistic emotion prompting and oversimplified language in robotic interactions can lead to the infantilization of vulnerable demographics, such as the elderly or cognitively impaired patients.
